facts.fact: The Guide helps financial institutions meet obligations under the Data Protection Act 2017, which requires entities to register as controllers, processors or collectors.
The Data Protection Commissioner, Drudeisha Madhub, attended the launch and her office will run DPO training.
Minister Avinash Ramtohul said on 29 October 2026 that only 23,000 of some 60,000 entities required to register under the Data Protection Act 2017 had done so.
